title: Keyframes to Video Flow: animate a set of drawings or 3D key poses on MiniMax H3
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1134 - Story and Infinite Video. Plan: tasks/MPI-1134/plan.md. Joined 2026-10-19 (Fabio, umbrella pass).  Idea, not a blocker (Fabio, 2026-10-18). Users with drawings or 3D animation that has only the main key poses drop in N pictures, set how many frames each one covers (a slider per picture), write one prompt; H3 makes the in-betweens. One MiniMaxH3AddGuide per picture at its frame_idx. Mid-shot / many-anchor runs are unproven: the MPI-1134 Phase 3 keyframe bench comes first. Brief: tasks/MPI-1191/brief.md.
